item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 11/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will continue to bring generally fine weather to southern China tomorrow. The monsoon is expected to be replaced gradually by a warm maritime airstream early next week, the weather will be humid and foggy over the coastal areas of Guangdong. Under the influence of the upper-air disturbance, there will be showers over southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
